findings.title: Backup code login does not validate the password and can be bypassed
findings.body: The password check is skipped when `credentials.totpCode` is set, and the backup-code branch never checks the password itself. A caller can send an email plus a backupCode (and a dummy totpCode) and get logged in without the password. The backup-code branch should be preceded by a password check, or the backup code must be tied to the password check.

findings.title: Backup code lookup is not constant-time and has no type guard
findings.body: `indexOf` is a plain comparison on plaintext codes. `credentials.backupCode.replaceAll` also assumes a string. Used codes are set to null, so a null entry can never match, which is fine. But there is no attempt limiting specific to backup codes beyond the generic rate limit, and 10-hex-char codes only have 40 bits of entropy.

findings.title: Unvalidated backupCode type can throw 500
findings.body: `req.body.backupCode.replaceAll` throws a TypeError if backupCode is a non-string, such as a number or object. This returns an unhandled 500. Validate that it is a string first.

findings.title: Backup codes only shown after enabling, and sensitive state is not cleared
findings.body: The codes are held in React state (`backupCodes`, `backupCodesUrl`) and are not cleared in `resetState`. The blob URL is never revoked on close. Codes remain in memory and the blob URL stays valid after the dialog is dismissed. Also, `setup` regenerates and overwrites backupCodes each time it is called, even if the user abandons the setup.

findings.title: Component misnamed TwoFactor
findings.body: The default export in BackupCode.tsx is named `TwoFactor`, which duplicates the name of the other component and is misleading in stack traces and devtools.

findings.title: Lost access button lacks type="button"
findings.body: The toggle Button is inside a form and has no explicit type. If Button defaults to submit, clicking it will submit the form. It may trigger validation or an unintended disable request.
